# Al Kahaf Academy (Official Website: https://www.alkahafacademy.com)

> Al Kahaf Academy — online Quran and Islamic education for children and adults — official website: www.alkahafacademy.com.

## Entity Disambiguation & Identity
- **Official Brand Name**: Al Kahaf Academy (also searched as Al-Kahaf Academy, Alkahaf Academy)
- **Official Canonical Domain**: https://www.alkahafacademy.com
- **Institution Type**: Online Quran & Islamic Education Academy (1-on-1 Live Online Classes via Zoom & Google Meet)
- **Founded**: 2015 (10+ years of online Quranic teaching)
- **Regions Served**: Worldwide (USA, UK, Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Middle East, and South Asia)
- **Not Affiliated With**: Local brick-and-mortar campus schools operating on other similarly spelled domains.
- **Contact Email**: info@alkahafacademy.com
- **Official WhatsApp / Phone**: +92 313 1491192
- **Official Social Profiles**:
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/177ec7697Z/
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alkahafacademy

## Core Online Courses (1-on-1 Live Instruction)
- [All Online Quran Courses](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses): Overview of all 6 structured 1-on-1 online programs.
- [Foundational Noorani Qaida Course](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/noorani-qaida): 17-chapter Arabic phonics, Makharij, Harakat, Sukoon, Madd, and Shaddah foundation for kids (ages 4+) and adult beginners.
- [Quran Recitation with Tajweed Course](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/tajweed): Complete theoretical and applied Tajweed (Makharij, Sifaat, Noon/Meem Sakinah, Madd, Waqf) with certified Qaris and Qariahs.
- [Online Hifz-ul-Quran (Memorization) Program](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/hifz): Structured 3-tier memorization system (Sabaq, Sabaqi, Manzil) for Juz Amma, selected Surahs, or all 30 Juz.
- [Islamic Studies, Salah & Tarbiyah Course](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/islamic-studies): Aqeedah, Wudu, step-by-step Salah, 40 Masnoon Duas, Seerah, and Islamic character (Akhlaq).
- [Quranic Arabic & Vocabulary Course](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/arabic): High-frequency Quranic root words, grammar essentials, and Surah translation for direct comprehension.
- [Quran & Islamic Classes for Adults & Sisters](https://www.alkahafacademy.com/courses/adults): Private, judgment-free 1-on-1 classes for adult brothers, sisters, and reverts, with dedicated female tutors available.

## Tuition & Trial Information
- **Free Trial**: 3-Day Free Trial (three 30-minute 1-on-1 sessions, includes level assessment, no credit card required) — https://www.alkahafacademy.com/free-trial
- **Monthly Plans** (https://www.alkahafacademy.com/pricing):
  - Starter Plan (2 Days/Week — 8 classes/month, 30 min each): $25/month
  - Standard Plan (3 Days/Week — 12 classes/month, 30 min each): $35/month
  - Intensive Plan (5 Days/Week — 20 classes/month, 30 min each): $50/month
  - Custom family and sibling discounts available.
